option_relations.rationale: HPV-related squamous cell carcinoma of the base of the tongue is a specific type and location of squamous cell carcinoma, which is a broader category that includes non-keratinizing invasive squamous cell carcinoma.

Oropharyngeal Cancer is a broader category that can include squamous cell carcinoma of the base of the tongue, which is a specific type of cancer. The provided leaf is a specific histological type of cancer that can occur in the oropharynx.
